title: Plus Size Tulle Sleeveless Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads in this stunning plus-size tulle evening dress! Featuring a sleeveless design and a flowing silhouette, this elegant gown is perfect for formal events, weddings, or galas. The soft tulle fabric adds a touch of romance, making you feel effortlessly glamorous.


Tips: Highly elastic fabric; stretches at least 2 inches.
Select based primarily on chest measurement.
Choose a smaller size for a snug fit.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
